rows.grounds: dvandva compound describing dual aspect of śaktiḥ
tatpuruṣa compound qualifying prakṛtiḥ or śaktiḥ

items.question: How can a single power be both supreme and non-supreme while deluding the universe?
premises: The power is described as one.
This same power is both supreme and non-supreme.
This power is primordial nature that deludes the universe.
items.inference: A single primordial power encompasses both transcendent and immanent aspects while functioning as the universe-deluding nature.
items.plain_english: There is one power, both supreme and non-supreme, which is the primordial nature that deludes the universe.
